findings.title: Anyone can read every player's email
findings.attack: A logged-out visitor calls /rest/v1/profiles?select=email with the public key and gets every email.
findings.disproof: Fresh check tried: is the table empty, or is RLS hiding rows? Ran it as anon: 42 rows with emails came back, so it's real.

findings.title: No column grants on profiles (extra layer)
findings.attack: Without column grants a player could try to update is_admin.
findings.disproof: Tried the update as a player: the trigger already rejects it, so this is a hardening note, not a vulnerability.

findings.title: Possible XSS in the leaderboard
findings.reason: Names go through textContent, never innerHTML (src/board.js line 12).

findings.title: EU VAT on digital sales may apply
findings.trigger: User answered: users in the EU; code has a Stripe checkout (no Merchant of Record).

findings.title: Accounts for under-13s need verified parental consent
findings.trigger: User answered: under-13s could use it; signup asks for an email.
